Top scalers. compute_top_scalers() ranks employment (HGE20) turnover (HGT20) scalers year three measures growth t-3 t: relative growth (rel), absolute growth (abs) Birch-Schreyer index (bs, mix ). keeps top 50 top 1, 5, 10 25 % describes group format step 5, share job turnover creation.
